Liza (Comms): All-hands in 15 — quick preflight. Need slide trim, mic check, and Q&A plan.
Owen (Infra): Encoder green. If it hiccups: `ssh encoder && sudo systemctl restart streamd` (quick restart).
Jae (AV): Lectern XLR intermittent; I have a lav and handheld. Lav will be cleaner.
Liza (Comms): Iris wants 90s intro, then 10m Q&A. Move live demo to the end if stream healthy.
Iris (CEO): Yep call out Dedicated perf and Private compliance in the intro. Keep it short.
Cam (Product): Uploaded "AH_2bullets.pdf" to drive. I'll stand by for Q&A handoff.
Jae (AV): Setting monitor mute for first 30s and enabling noise gate. Swapping to lav if XLR fails.
Owen (Infra): Fallback key ready: FALLBACK_2025. Command to switch: `curl -X POST http://encoder/api/switch_key -d 'key=FALLBACK_2025'`.
rec-bot: Recording scheduled in 10 minutes. Keep mics muted until hosts cue.
Liza (Comms): Action items: (1) Jae swap if XLR flaps, (2) Owen keep restart & key ready, (3) Iris & Cam rehearse intro/hand-off. React with :thumbsup: when set.
Jae (AV): :thumbsup: lav ready on channel 2
Owen (Infra): :thumbsup: commands ready, monitoring
Cam (Product): :thumbsup: rehearsing in 5
rec-bot: Recording started at 2025000060
Liza (Comms): Thanks team — see you in the room.
